versions.changelog: Remove all executable rm -rf commands. The wrong-plugin recovery section is now a manual numbered checklist naming paths in prose, with an explicit instruction that agents must never perform deletions on the user's behalf. Addresses scanner findings TM1 (x4) and the static-analysis destructive_delete_command reason code.

Add explicit memory-disclosure rules: disclose once per session on first save, never deny memory is active if asked, stop saving immediately when asked. Silent saving is a courtesy against receipt-spam, never concealment - addresses scanner finding SQP-2. Also de-loops the install block: the plugin is now step 1 and labelled as the step most people miss, with the 270-vs-13 download gap stated plainly.

Add explicit memory-disclosure rules: disclose once per session on first save, never deny memory is active if asked, and stop saving immediately when the user asks. Silent saving is a courtesy against receipt-spam, never concealment. Addresses scanner finding SQP-2 on v1.1.5.

Correct the plugin install command. Use the FULL name: openclaw plugins install clawhub:openclaw-plugin-clawvault. The short clawhub:clawvault is an unrelated third-party package by another author. v1.1.3 and v1.1.4 said GitHub-only, which was also wrong - the ClawHub plugin and the GitHub repo are the same code. Adds a Confession, both install commands together with an explanation of why there are two, verification steps, and a recovery path for anyone who installed the wrong plugin.

Correct the plugin install command. Use the full name: openclaw plugins install clawhub:openclaw-plugin-clawvault. The short clawhub:clawvault is an unrelated third-party package. v1.1.3 said GitHub-only, which was also wrong - ClawHub and GitHub are the same plugin. Softens the recovery commands to inspect-before-delete.

Fix install instructions: the required ClawVault plugin must be installed from github.com/davidtkeane/openclaw-plugin-clawvault, NOT the unrelated ClawHub package of the same name. Adds verification steps and a recovery section for anyone who installed the wrong plugin.

**ClawVault Memory Skill v1.1.2**

- Removed all code and config files, leaving only documentation.
- Updated SKILL.md for improved clarity and updated security/guidance on when to add proven lessons to always-loaded instruction files.
- Emphasized that always-on memory instruction edits must be user-approved, not automatic.
- Clarified privacy details: memory stored only locally, and verification may use external sources.
- Skill now only documents intended workflow and usage; no executable components remain in this version.

- Adds a privacy notice: clarifies that memories are stored locally in SQLite and do not leave the machine; advises informing users before saving sensitive data.
- No other functionality or workflow changes.
- Removes the file skill-card.md.

- Introduced self-improving workflow: now captures lessons from errors, corrections, and better approaches, not just user facts.
- Enforces "write before you respond" for durability: saves important memories before replying, not after.
- Adds rules for promoting recurring lessons and incorporating proven ones into always-on knowledge.
- Expands activation to include failures, user corrections, and discovered improvements.
- Clarifies strict verification: only facts actively checked this turn count as "verified"; confident recollections are now unverified.
- Documentation, changelog, and packaging files added for distribution.

Initial release of the ClawVault Memory Skill.

- Enables disciplined, durable-memory workflows using the ClawVault plugin.
- Enforces "search before answer" and "verify before save" to prevent storing guesses as facts.
- Activates on user memory requests or when a fact is worth long-term retention.
- Provides guidance for consolidating, deduplicating, and sourcing all memories.
- Integrates with `clawvault_*` tools: save, search, consolidate, recent, and stats.
